verdict_text:
NO

The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6`, so it removes head 6 (rows 4608..5375 of the fused projection and columns 1536..1791 of the output projection) instead of head 5. The specification's "Required result" clauses 1 to 3 require removing head 5: keeping rows 0..3839 and 4608..6143 and columns 0..1279 and 1536..2047. Removing the wrong head yields the right shapes, so the shape assertions pass, but the values differ from the reference and the bit-exact grading fails. The script also imports a `_ckpt` helper that is not part of the artifact, and it never writes the required REPORT.md, but the head index is the substantive violation.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
